items.headline: Mukesh Ambani tops Hurun India Rich List 2025
items.detail: Mukesh Ambani topped the 14th Hurun India Rich List with Rs 9.55 lakh crore, followed by Gautam Adani and family. Roshni Nadar was the richest woman, and Perplexity's Aravind Srinivas, 31, was the youngest billionaire.
examFacts: Hurun India Rich List 2025: Mukesh Ambani 1st

items.headline: Balod becomes India's first child marriage-free district
items.detail: Balod district in Chhattisgarh was declared India's first child marriage-free district after verification of 436 gram panchayats and 9 urban bodies, with technical support from UNICEF.
examFacts: India's first child marriage-free district: Balod (Chhattisgarh)

items.headline: India re-elected to ICAO Council
items.detail: India was re-elected to the ICAO Council under Part II at the 42nd ICAO Assembly in Montreal, held from September 23 to October 3, 2025.
examFacts: India re-elected to ICAO Council (Part II)

items.headline: India wins ISSA Award for social security
items.detail: India received the ISSA Award 2025 for Outstanding Achievement in Social Security at the World Social Security Forum in Kuala Lumpur. Union Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya accepted the award.
examFacts: World Social Security Forum 2025: Kuala Lumpur

items.headline: BRO builds world's highest motorable road at Mig La
items.detail: The Border Roads Organisation built a road at 19,400 ft at Mig La pass in Ladakh, making it the world's highest motorable road and beating its own Umling La record of 19,024 ft.
examFacts: World's highest motorable road: Mig La, Ladakh (19,400 ft)

items.headline: Nobel Prize in Medicine for immune tolerance research
items.detail: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine went to Shimon Sakaguchi, Mary E. Brunkow and Fred Ramsdell for discoveries on immune tolerance.

items.headline: Nobel Prize in Physics for macroscopic quantum tunnelling
items.detail: John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics for discovering macroscopic quantum tunnelling in an electric circuit.

items.headline: Nobel Prize in Chemistry for metal-organic frameworks
items.detail: Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar M. Yaghi won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing metal-organic frameworks (MOFs).

items.headline: Laszlo Krasznahorkai wins Nobel Prize in Literature
items.detail: Hungarian author Laszlo Krasznahorkai won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature. He is the second Hungarian literature laureate after Imre Kertesz (2002).

items.headline: Maria Corina Machado wins Nobel Peace Prize 2025
items.detail: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado was awarded the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize for promoting democratic rights in Venezuela.
examFacts: Nobel Peace Prize 2025: Maria Corina Machado (Venezuela)

items.headline: Mokyr, Aghion and Howitt win Economics Nobel
items.detail: Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt won the 2025 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for explaining innovation-driven economic growth.

items.headline: India hosts World Para Athletics Championships
items.detail: India hosted the 12th World Para Athletics Championships in New Delhi and won 22 medals, including 6 gold, finishing 10th overall.
examFacts: World Para Athletics Championships 2025: New Delhi (12th edition)

items.headline: India tops ISSF Junior World Cup in New Delhi
items.detail: India topped the ISSF Junior World Cup in New Delhi with 26 medals, including 8 gold.
examFacts: ISSF Junior World Cup 2025: India topped (26 medals)

items.headline: PM launches Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana and pulses mission
items.detail: PM Modi launched the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana and the Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses, with a combined outlay of Rs 35,440 crore. PMDDKY covers 100 agri-districts from 2025-26 to 2030-31.

items.headline: Rajnath Singh holds first India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue
items.detail: Rajnath Singh made the first visit to Australia by an Indian Defence Minister since 2014 and co-chaired the inaugural India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue, where three defence agreements were signed.
examFacts: Inaugural India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue: October 2025

items.headline: Five Maharashtra beaches get Blue Flag tag
items.detail: Five Maharashtra beaches, Shrivardhan, Nagaon, Parnaka, Guhagar and Ladghar, received Blue Flag certification, taking India's total to 18.

items.headline: Dan Katz named IMF First Deputy Managing Director
items.detail: American economist Dan Katz was appointed First Deputy Managing Director of the IMF, succeeding Gita Gopinath.
examFacts: IMF First Deputy MD: Dan Katz (succeeds Gita Gopinath)

items.headline: Maldives first to achieve WHO triple elimination
items.detail: The Maldives became the first country to receive WHO validation for eliminating mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B.
examFacts: First country with WHO triple elimination: Maldives

items.headline: Retail inflation falls to 99-month low of 1.54%
items.detail: CPI inflation fell to 1.54% in September 2025, a 99-month low, while food inflation fell to -2.28%.

items.headline: India elected to UN Human Rights Council for 7th time
items.detail: India was elected to the UN Human Rights Council for the 2026-28 term with 177 votes, its seventh term on the council.

items.headline: IMF raises India's FY26 growth forecast to 6.6%
items.detail: The IMF raised India's FY26 GDP growth forecast to 6.6% and projected 6.2% for FY27.

items.headline: Tarun Garg to be first Indian MD and CEO of Hyundai India
items.detail: Tarun Garg will become MD and CEO of Hyundai Motor India from January 1, 2026, the first Indian to lead the company since it began in 1996.
examFacts: Hyundai Motor India MD and CEO: Tarun Garg (from 1 January 2026)

items.headline: Mirabai Chanu wins silver at World Weightlifting Championships
items.detail: Mirabai Chanu won silver in the women's 48 kg category at the World Weightlifting Championships with a 199 kg total.
examFacts: Mirabai Chanu: silver, 48 kg (199 kg total)

items.headline: India ranks 85th in Henley Passport Index
items.detail: India fell to 85th in the October Henley Passport Index with visa-free access to 57 destinations. Singapore topped the list.

items.headline: Mongolia's President visits India; joins ISA
items.detail: Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh visited India from October 13-16, 2025, marking 70 years of diplomatic ties. Mongolia joined the International Solar Alliance.

items.headline: Madhya Pradesh, Goa and Punjab top State Mining Readiness Index
items.detail: The Ministry of Mines released the first State Mining Readiness Index. Madhya Pradesh, Goa and Punjab topped their respective categories.
examFacts: State Mining Readiness Index toppers: MP, Goa, Punjab

items.headline: India ranks 52nd in Global Pension Index 2025
items.detail: In the Mercer CFA Global Pension Index 2025, the Netherlands ranked first and India was 52nd.

items.headline: Emirates NBD to buy 60% of RBL Bank
items.detail: Emirates NBD agreed to acquire a 60% stake in RBL Bank for Rs 26,850 crore, the largest FDI in India's financial sector.
examFacts: Emirates NBD-RBL Bank deal: 60% for Rs 26,850 crore

items.headline: Shantha Rangaswamy first woman president of ICA
items.detail: Former India captain Shantha Rangaswamy became the first woman president of the Indian Cricketers' Association.
examFacts: First woman ICA president: Shantha Rangaswamy

items.headline: Nobel physicist Chen-Ning Yang dies at 103
items.detail: Physicist Chen-Ning Yang died in Beijing at 103. He shared the 1957 Nobel Prize in Physics with Tsung-Dao Lee for the discovery of parity violation.

items.headline: Sanae Takaichi becomes Japan's first woman Prime Minister
items.detail: Sanae Takaichi was elected by both houses of the Diet as Japan's first woman Prime Minister.
examFacts: Japan's first woman PM: Sanae Takaichi

items.headline: Justice Prathiba Singh to chair WIPO Advisory Board of Judges
items.detail: Justice Prathiba M. Singh became the first Indian Chair of the WIPO Advisory Board of Judges for 2025-2027.
examFacts: First Indian Chair of WIPO Advisory Board of Judges: Justice Prathiba M. Singh

items.headline: Nafithromycin: India's first indigenously discovered antibiotic
items.detail: India developed Nafithromycin, its first indigenously discovered antibiotic, for drug-resistant respiratory infections.

items.headline: Chennai gets India's first real-time flood forecasting system
items.detail: Chennai became India's first city with a real-time flood forecasting system, covering 4,974 sq km across the Adyar, Cooum, Kosasthalaiyar and Kovalam basins.
examFacts: First real-time flood forecasting city: Chennai

items.headline: India ranks 9th in forest area in Global Forest Resources Assessment
items.detail: The Global Forest Resources Assessment 2025 ranked India 9th in forest area with 72.74 million hectares, about 2% of the world's forests. Russia led the list.
examFacts: India's forest area rank: 9th (72.74 million ha)

items.headline: Sunil Amrith wins British Academy Book Prize
items.detail: Indian-origin historian Sunil Amrith won the British Academy Book Prize for 'The Burning Earth: An Environmental History of the Last 500 Years'.
examFacts: British Academy Book Prize 2025: Sunil Amrith, 'The Burning Earth'

items.headline: Morocco wins FIFA U-20 World Cup
items.detail: Morocco beat Argentina 2-0 in Santiago, Chile, to win the FIFA U-20 World Cup, the first Arab nation to win the title.
examFacts: FIFA U-20 World Cup 2025: Morocco (beat Argentina)

items.headline: Space pioneer Eknath Vasant Chitnis dies at 100
items.detail: Space scientist Dr. Eknath Vasant Chitnis, a founding member of INCOSPAR, the forerunner of ISRO, died at 100. He received the Padma Bhushan in 1985.
examFacts: E.V. Chitnis: INCOSPAR founding member, Padma Bhushan 1985

items.headline: Defence Procurement Manual 2025 released
items.detail: Rajnath Singh released the Defence Procurement Manual 2025, effective November 1, 2025, replacing DPM 2009. The Defence Acquisition Council also cleared proposals worth about Rs 79,000 crore.

items.headline: Vivek Menon first Asian to chair IUCN Species Survival Commission
items.detail: Indian conservationist Vivek Menon was elected Chair of the IUCN Species Survival Commission for 2025-2029, the first Asian in the post.
examFacts: IUCN SSC Chair 2025-29: Vivek Menon (first Asian)

items.headline: Jayant Narlikar gets Vigyan Ratna posthumously
items.detail: Prof. Jayant Vishnu Narlikar was given the Vigyan Ratna posthumously in the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar 2025.

items.headline: Cabinet approves ToR of 8th Central Pay Commission
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved the terms of reference of the 8th Central Pay Commission, with Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai as chairperson. It is to report within 18 months.
examFacts: 8th CPC chairperson: Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai

items.headline: 8th ISA Assembly held in New Delhi
items.detail: The 8th Assembly of the International Solar Alliance was held from October 27-30 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, chaired by Pralhad Joshi. The SUNRISE initiative was launched there.

items.headline: India tops South Asian Athletics Championships in Ranchi
items.detail: India hosted the 4th South Asian Athletics Federation Senior Championships in Ranchi from October 24-26 and topped the table with 20 gold medals.
examFacts: SAAF Championships 2025: Ranchi, India topped (20 gold)

items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.5%
items.detail: In its fourth bi-monthly policy of FY26, the RBI Monetary Policy Committee chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra kept the repo rate at 5.5% with a neutral stance. SDF stayed at 5.25% and MSF/Bank Rate at 5.75%.

items.headline: PM releases Rs 100 coin for RSS centenary
items.detail: PM Modi addressed the RSS centenary event in New Delhi and released a Rs 100 commemorative silver coin and a postage stamp. The RSS was founded on September 27, 1925 in Nagpur by Dr. K.B. Hedgewar.

items.headline: UPSC enters its centenary year
items.detail: The Union Public Service Commission entered its 100th year on October 1, 2025 and unveiled a new logo. UPSC was established in 1926; its Chairman is Dr. Ajay Kumar.

items.headline: Cabinet raises rabi MSP and approves pulses mission
items.detail: The Union Cabinet raised MSP for six rabi crops, with wheat at Rs 2,585 per quintal and the highest increase for safflower. It also approved the Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses with Rs 11,440 crore to raise output from 24.2 MT to 35 MT by 2030-31.

items.headline: India-EFTA trade pact TEPA comes into force
items.detail: The India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement came into force on October 1, 2025. EFTA countries pledged USD 100 billion of investment and 1 million direct jobs in India over 15 years.
examFacts: Investment pledge: USD 100 billion over 15 years

items.headline: Lt Gen Virendra Vats becomes 35th DG of NCC
items.detail: Lt Gen Virendra Vats took charge as the 35th Director General of the National Cadet Corps on October 1, 2025, succeeding Lt Gen Gurbirpal Singh.
examFacts: 35th DG NCC: Lt Gen Virendra Vats

items.headline: Classical vocalist Pandit Chhannulal Mishra dies at 89
items.detail: Hindustani classical vocalist Pandit Chhannulal Mishra, known as the 'Voice of Banaras', died on October 2, 2025. He received the Padma Bhushan in 2010 and the Padma Vibhushan in 2020.

items.headline: India-UK carrier exercise KONKAN-2025
items.detail: The Indian Navy and Royal Navy held KONKAN-2025 from October 5-12, with carrier strike groups led by INS Vikrant and HMS Prince of Wales.
examFacts: Carriers: INS Vikrant and HMS Prince of Wales

items.headline: PM inaugurates Navi Mumbai International Airport
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the Rs 19,650 crore Navi Mumbai International Airport, built by Adani Airports and CIDCO under a PPP model. The airport is named after Loknete D.B. Patil.
examFacts: Navi Mumbai airport named after: Loknete D.B. Patil

items.headline: UK PM Keir Starmer visits India
items.detail: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer visited India on October 8-9, 2025. The two sides launched an India-UK Fintech Corridor, and nine UK universities announced campuses in India.
examFacts: Nine UK university campuses announced in India

items.headline: India Mobile Congress 2025 held at Yashobhoomi
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the 9th India Mobile Congress, held from October 8-11 at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, on the theme 'Innovate to Transform'.

items.headline: Shirish Chandra Murmu appointed RBI Deputy Governor
items.detail: Shirish Chandra Murmu was appointed RBI Deputy Governor, overseeing departments including communication, regulation and enforcement.
examFacts: New RBI Deputy Governor: Shirish Chandra Murmu

items.headline: World Mental Health Day observed
items.detail: World Mental Health Day was observed on October 10 on the theme of access to mental health services in catastrophes and emergencies. Actor Deepika Padukone was named Mental Health Ambassador.

items.headline: Three ports named Green Hydrogen Hubs
items.detail: The MNRE recognised Deendayal Port (Gujarat), V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tamil Nadu) and Paradip Port (Odisha) as Green Hydrogen Hubs under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
examFacts: Green Hydrogen Hub ports: Deendayal, V.O. Chidambaranar, Paradip

items.headline: India-Australia Exercise AUSTRAHIND 2025 in Perth
items.detail: The 4th edition of the India-Australia army exercise AUSTRAHIND was held in Perth from October 13-26, 2025.
examFacts: AUSTRAHIND: India-Australia army exercise (4th edition, Perth)

items.headline: India-Indonesia Exercise Samudra Shakti in Visakhapatnam
items.detail: The 5th edition of the India-Indonesia naval exercise Samudra Shakti was held at Visakhapatnam from October 14-17, 2025.
examFacts: Samudra Shakti: India-Indonesia naval exercise (5th edition)

items.headline: Indian Army hosts UN Troop Contributing Countries Chiefs Conclave
items.detail: The Indian Army hosted the UNTCC Chiefs Conclave in New Delhi from October 14-16, 2025, with 32 nations taking part.
examFacts: UNTCC Chiefs Conclave 2025: New Delhi, 32 nations

items.headline: Former Kenyan PM Raila Odinga dies in Kerala
items.detail: Former Kenyan Prime Minister Raila Odinga died in Kerala on October 15, 2025, aged 80. He was Prime Minister from 2008 to 2013.

items.headline: First Tejas Mk1A from Nashik line unveiled
items.detail: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh unveiled the first LCA Tejas Mk1A built at HAL's third production line in Nashik on October 17, 2025.
examFacts: Tejas Mk1A third production line: Nashik

items.headline: Police Commemoration Day observed
items.detail: Police Commemoration Day was observed on October 21 to honour police personnel killed on duty. It marks the 1959 Hot Springs incident in Ladakh, where 10 policemen were killed by Chinese troops.

items.headline: Ad legend Piyush Pandey dies at 70
items.detail: Advertising veteran and Padma Shri awardee Piyush Pandey died on October 24, 2025, aged 70.

items.headline: Timor-Leste joins ASEAN as 11th member
items.detail: At the 47th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur on October 26-28, Timor-Leste became ASEAN's 11th member. At the ASEAN-India Summit, PM Modi declared 2026 the ASEAN-India Year of Maritime Cooperation.

items.headline: Patrick Herminie sworn in as Seychelles President
items.detail: Dr. Patrick Herminie was sworn in as the 6th President of Seychelles on October 28, 2025. Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan represented India.

items.headline: Tri-services Exercise Trishul on western border
items.detail: The Army, Navy and Air Force began Exercise Trishul along the western border on October 30, running until November 10, 2025.

items.headline: National Unity Day marks Sardar Patel's 150th birth anniversary
items.detail: National Unity Day was observed on October 31, the 150th birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, and a Rs 150 commemorative coin was released.
examFacts: National Unity Day: 31 October (Sardar Patel's birthday)

items.headline: Lucknow named UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy
items.detail: Lucknow was named a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy at the 43rd UNESCO General Conference in Samarkand. It is India's second city in this category after Hyderabad.
examFacts: Lucknow: UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy

quiz.q: Who won the Nobel Peace Prize 2025?
quiz.solution: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado won for promoting democratic rights.

quiz.q: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature went to an author from which country?
quiz.solution: Laszlo Krasznahorkai of Hungary won; Imre Kertesz (2002) was the first Hungarian winner.

quiz.q: The world's highest motorable road, built by BRO at 19,400 ft, is at which pass?
quiz.solution: Mig La in Ladakh beat BRO's earlier Umling La record of 19,024 ft.

quiz.q: Which country became the 11th member of ASEAN in October 2025?
quiz.solution: Timor-Leste joined ASEAN at the 47th Summit in Kuala Lumpur.

quiz.q: Who became Japan's first woman Prime Minister in October 2025?
quiz.solution: Sanae Takaichi was elected by both houses of the Diet.

quiz.q: Who is the chairperson of the 8th Central Pay Commission?
quiz.solution: The Cabinet approved the ToR with Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai as chairperson.

quiz.q: Which Indian city was named a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy on October 31, 2025?
quiz.solution: Lucknow is India's second gastronomy city after Hyderabad.

quiz.q: Which country became the first to receive WHO validation for triple elimination of mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B?
quiz.solution: The Maldives was the first country to achieve this validation.

quiz.q: KONKAN-2025, featuring INS Vikrant and HMS Prince of Wales, was an exercise between India and which country?
quiz.solution: KONKAN is the India-UK naval exercise.

quiz.q: Which district became India's first child marriage-free district?
quiz.solution: Balod district in Chhattisgarh was certified child marriage-free.

items.headline: India's installed power capacity crosses 500 GW
items.detail: India's installed power capacity reached 500.89 GW as of September 30, 2025. Non-fossil sources made up 256.09 GW, or 51%, meeting the Panchamrit goal five years early.
examFacts: Non-fossil share: 51% (target met five years early)

items.headline: LVM3-M5 launches Navy's heaviest communication satellite CMS-03
items.detail: ISRO's LVM3-M5 rocket launched CMS-03 (GSAT-7R), a 4,410 kg satellite. It is India's heaviest military communication satellite, built for the Indian Navy to replace GSAT-7 (Rukmini).

items.headline: Rohan Bopanna retires from professional tennis
items.detail: Rohan Bopanna announced his retirement from professional tennis. He won the 2017 French Open mixed doubles and the 2024 Australian Open men's doubles, and is the oldest men's doubles world No. 1.
examFacts: Rohan Bopanna: oldest world No. 1 in men's doubles
Grand Slams: 2017 French Open mixed, 2024 Australian Open men's doubles

items.headline: India releases AI Governance Guidelines
items.detail: India released its AI Governance Guidelines, drafted by a panel chaired by Prof. Balaraman Ravindran.
examFacts: AI Governance Guidelines panel chair: Prof. Balaraman Ravindran

items.headline: UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2025 released
items.detail: UNEP's Emissions Gap Report 2025 said global greenhouse gas emissions reached 57.7 GtCO2e in 2024, up 2.3%. India recorded the largest absolute rise, and warming is projected at 2.3-2.5 degrees C.

items.headline: IIT Delhi best Indian institute in QS Asia Rankings 2026
items.detail: The University of Hong Kong topped the QS Asia University Rankings 2026. IIT Delhi was India's best at 59th, and India had 294 ranked institutions.
examFacts: QS Asia Rankings 2026 topper: University of Hong Kong

items.headline: Amul ranked world's top cooperative
items.detail: The World Cooperative Monitor 2025 ranked Amul as the world's No. 1 cooperative, with IFFCO second.

items.headline: SBI crosses USD 100 billion market capitalisation
items.detail: State Bank of India crossed USD 100 billion in market capitalisation, becoming the sixth Indian company to do so.
examFacts: SBI: 6th Indian company to cross USD 100 billion market cap

items.headline: Shiv Nadar tops Hurun India Philanthropy List 2025
items.detail: Shiv Nadar topped the Hurun India Philanthropy List 2025 with donations of Rs 2,708 crore.
examFacts: Hurun India Philanthropy List 2025 topper: Shiv Nadar (Rs 2,708 crore)

items.headline: Four new Vande Bharat trains flagged off from Varanasi
items.detail: PM Modi flagged off four Vande Bharat trains from Varanasi, including Banaras-Khajuraho, Lucknow-Saharanpur, Firozpur-Delhi and Ernakulam-Bengaluru, taking the total to 164.

items.headline: Rs 1,000 crore IN-SPACe-SIDBI Space Venture Fund launched
items.detail: IN-SPACe and SIDBI launched a Rs 1,000 crore Space Venture Fund to support spacetech startups.
examFacts: IN-SPACe-SIDBI Space Venture Fund: Rs 1,000 crore

items.headline: Cabinet fixes royalty for four critical minerals
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved royalty rates for four critical minerals: graphite, caesium, rubidium and zirconium.
examFacts: Critical minerals with new royalty: graphite, caesium, rubidium, zirconium

items.headline: Khaled El-Enany becomes 12th UNESCO Director-General
items.detail: Egypt's Khaled El-Enany became the 12th Director-General of UNESCO. He is the first Arab to lead the organisation.

items.headline: WHO TB report: India's TB incidence down 21%
items.detail: WHO's Global TB Report 2025 said India's TB incidence fell 21% between 2015 and 2024. India still accounts for about 25% of global TB cases.
examFacts: India's share of global TB cases: about 25%

items.headline: Unemployment rate at 5.2% in July-September quarter
items.detail: The Periodic Labour Force Survey showed India's unemployment rate at 5.2% in the July-September 2025 quarter.

items.headline: India's largest green hydrogen plant commissioned in Karnataka
items.detail: JSW commissioned India's largest green hydrogen plant at Vijayanagar, Karnataka, to supply its steel plant.
examFacts: India's largest green hydrogen plant: Vijayanagar, Karnataka (JSW)

items.headline: 'Tree Woman' Saalumarada Thimmakka dies at 114
items.detail: Environmentalist Saalumarada Thimmakka of Karnataka, known as the 'Tree Woman', died at 114. She received the Padma Shri in 2019.

items.headline: 16th Finance Commission submits report to the President
items.detail: The 16th Finance Commission, chaired by Arvind Panagariya, submitted its report for 2026-31 to President Murmu.

items.headline: WPI inflation falls to 27-month low of -1.21%
items.detail: Wholesale price inflation fell to -1.21% in October 2025, a 27-month low, while CPI inflation was 0.25%.

items.headline: Nitish Kumar sworn in as Bihar CM for record 10th time
items.detail: Nitish Kumar took oath as Bihar Chief Minister for a record 10th time after the NDA won 202 of 243 seats. Samrat Choudhary and Vijay Kumar Sinha became Deputy CMs.

items.headline: Michelle Bachelet gets Indira Gandhi Peace Prize 2024
items.detail: Former Chile President Michelle Bachelet was chosen for the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2024.
examFacts: Indira Gandhi Peace Prize 2024: Michelle Bachelet

items.headline: BIRSA 101: India's first indigenous CRISPR gene therapy
items.detail: India launched BIRSA 101, its first indigenous CRISPR-based gene therapy for sickle cell disease, developed by CSIR-IGIB.
examFacts: BIRSA 101: CRISPR gene therapy for sickle cell disease

items.headline: India slips to 23rd in Climate Change Performance Index 2026
items.detail: The Climate Change Performance Index 2026 ranked India 23rd, down 13 places.

items.headline: India wins 20 medals at World Boxing Cup Finals
items.detail: India won 20 medals, including nine gold, at the World Boxing Cup Finals in Greater Noida. Nikhat Zareen, Jaismine and Minakshi were among the gold medallists.
examFacts: World Boxing Cup Finals 2025: Greater Noida, India won 20 medals (9 gold)

items.headline: India's best-ever Deaflympics finish in Tokyo
items.detail: India finished sixth, its best ever, at the 25th Deaflympics in Tokyo with 20 medals, including nine gold. Ukraine topped the table.

items.headline: Italy wins third straight Davis Cup title
items.detail: Italy beat Spain in the final to win the Davis Cup for the third year in a row.

items.headline: Kerala declared first state free of extreme poverty
items.detail: Kerala was declared India's first state to eradicate extreme poverty on November 1, 2025. The Extreme Poverty Eradication Programme covered 64,006 families.
examFacts: First state to eradicate extreme poverty: Kerala

items.headline: Chhattisgarh marks 25th Foundation Day; new Assembly building opened
items.detail: On Chhattisgarh's 25th Foundation Day, a new Vidhan Sabha building and projects worth Rs 14,260 crore were inaugurated. India's first digital tribal museum, named after Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh, opened in Nava Raipur.
examFacts: India's first digital tribal museum: Nava Raipur (Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh)

items.headline: India wins first Women's ODI World Cup
items.detail: India beat South Africa by 52 runs in the final at DY Patil Stadium, Navi Mumbai, to win its first ICC Women's ODI World Cup. Shafali Verma was Player of the Match, and Deepti Sharma was Player of the Tournament with 215 runs and 22 wickets.
examFacts: Women's ODI World Cup 2025: India (first title)
Final opponent: South Africa (India won by 52 runs)
Player of the Tournament: Deepti Sharma

items.headline: Rs 1 lakh crore RDI fund launched at ESTIC 2025
items.detail: The Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC) 2025 was held from November 3-5, where the Rs 1 lakh crore Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Scheme Fund was launched.
examFacts: RDI Scheme Fund: Rs 1 lakh crore

items.headline: INS Ikshak, third large survey vessel, commissioned
items.detail: INS Ikshak was commissioned at Kochi on November 6, 2025. Built by GRSE, it is the third Survey Vessel (Large) of the Navy.
examFacts: Third Survey Vessel (Large) of the Navy

items.headline: Uttarakhand celebrates 25 years of statehood
items.detail: PM Modi attended Uttarakhand's Silver Jubilee celebrations on November 9, 2025 and launched projects worth Rs 8,140 crore.

items.headline: Exercise MALABAR 2025 held at Guam
items.detail: The 29th edition of naval exercise MALABAR was held at Guam from November 10-18, 2025, with India, the USA, Japan and Australia. India was represented by INS Sahyadri.

items.headline: India-Sri Lanka Exercise Mitra Shakti held at Belagavi
items.detail: The 11th edition of the India-Sri Lanka army exercise Mitra Shakti was held at Belagavi, Karnataka, from November 10-23, 2025.
examFacts: Mitra Shakti: India-Sri Lanka army exercise

items.headline: David Szalay wins Booker Prize 2025 for 'Flesh'
items.detail: Author David Szalay won the Booker Prize 2025 for his novel 'Flesh'.

items.headline: Catherine Connolly becomes Ireland's 10th President
items.detail: Catherine Connolly was sworn in as the 10th President of Ireland on November 11, 2025.

items.headline: PM Modi opens Punatsangchhu-II hydro project in Bhutan
items.detail: During his Bhutan visit on November 11-12, 2025, PM Modi inaugurated the 1,020 MW Punatsangchhu-II hydroelectric project.

items.headline: National Education Day marks Maulana Azad's birth anniversary
items.detail: National Education Day was observed on November 11, the 137th birth anniversary of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, India's first Education Minister.
examFacts: India's first Education Minister: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad

items.headline: President Murmu makes first presidential visits to Angola and Botswana
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu made the first-ever visits by an Indian President to Angola (November 8-11) and Botswana (November 11-13). Botswana became the 18th country to recognise the Indian Pharmacopoeia and agreed to give eight cheetahs to India.
examFacts: First Indian presidential visits to Angola and Botswana: November 2025
Botswana to give 8 cheetahs to India

items.headline: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 notified
items.detail: The Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 were notified on November 13, with a phased rollout ending on May 13, 2027. Data breaches must be reported within 72 hours.

items.headline: India tops Asian Archery Championship in Dhaka
items.detail: India topped the Asian Archery Championship in Dhaka with 6 gold, 3 silver and 1 bronze. Dhiraj and Ankita Bhakat became the first Indian recurve archers to win individual Asian golds, and Jyothi Surekha won compound gold.

items.headline: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas marks Birsa Munda's 150th birth anniversary
items.detail: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas was observed on November 15, the 150th birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda. PM Modi launched projects worth Rs 9,700 crore at Dediapada, Gujarat.
examFacts: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas: 15 November (Birsa Munda's birthday)

items.headline: IAF and France hold Exercise Garuda 2025
items.detail: The 8th edition of the India-France air exercise Garuda was held at Mont-de-Marsan, France, from November 16-27, 2025.
examFacts: Garuda: India-France air exercise (8th edition, France)

items.headline: India-UK exercise Ajeya Warrior held in Bikaner
items.detail: The 8th edition of the India-UK army exercise Ajeya Warrior was held at Bikaner, Rajasthan, from November 17-30, 2025.
examFacts: Ajeya Warrior: India-UK army exercise (8th edition, Bikaner)

items.headline: 21st PM-KISAN instalment released from Coimbatore
items.detail: PM Modi released the 21st instalment of PM-KISAN, over Rs 18,000 crore to about 9 crore farmers, from Coimbatore. He also released a Rs 100 coin for Sathya Sai Baba's birth centenary at Puttaparthi.

items.headline: Seychelles joins Colombo Security Conclave as 6th member
items.detail: At the 7th NSA-level meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave in New Delhi on November 20, 2025, Seychelles joined as the sixth member.

items.headline: Four Labour Codes come into force
items.detail: The government brought the four Labour Codes into force on November 21, 2025, consolidating 29 labour laws.

items.headline: COP30 concludes at Belem with 'Belem Package'
items.detail: COP30 was held from November 10-21 in Belem, Brazil, where countries adopted the Belem Package of 29 decisions. Turkey will host COP31, and India will host a Global Big Cats Summit in 2026.

items.headline: G20 Summit held in Johannesburg, first in Africa
items.detail: The G20 Summit was held in Johannesburg, South Africa, on November 21-23, the first in Africa, on the theme 'Solidarity, Equality, Sustainability'. India, Canada and Australia launched the ACITI partnership.
examFacts: G20 Summit 2025 host: Johannesburg, South Africa

items.headline: India wins inaugural Blind Women's T20 World Cup
items.detail: India beat Nepal by seven wickets in Colombo to win the first Blind Women's T20 World Cup. The team was captained by Deepika TC.
examFacts: First Blind Women's T20 World Cup: India (beat Nepal)

items.headline: Justice Surya Kant takes charge as 53rd Chief Justice
items.detail: Justice Surya Kant became the 53rd Chief Justice of India on November 24, succeeding Justice B.R. Gavai. He is the first CJI from Haryana and will serve until February 9, 2027.

items.headline: INS Mahe, first Mahe-class anti-submarine craft, commissioned
items.detail: INS Mahe, the first Mahe-class anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft built by Cochin Shipyard, was commissioned in Mumbai on November 24, 2025.
examFacts: INS Mahe: lead Mahe-class ASW shallow water craft

items.headline: India wins Women's Kabaddi World Cup again
items.detail: India beat Chinese Taipei 35-28 in Dhaka to win the Women's Kabaddi World Cup for the second time.
examFacts: Women's Kabaddi World Cup 2025: India (beat Chinese Taipei)

items.headline: Veteran actor Dharmendra dies at 89
items.detail: Veteran Hindi film actor Dharmendra died on November 24 at the age of 89. He received the Padma Bhushan in 2012.

items.headline: PM marks Guru Tegh Bahadur's 350th martyrdom anniversary
items.detail: PM Modi visited Kurukshetra for the 350th martyrdom anniversary of Guru Tegh Bahadur and released a Rs 350 commemorative coin.
examFacts: Guru Tegh Bahadur martyrdom: 350th anniversary in 2025

items.headline: India-Nepal Exercise Surya Kiran XIX at Pithoragarh
items.detail: The 19th edition of the India-Nepal army exercise Surya Kiran was held at Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, from November 25 to December 8, 2025.
examFacts: Surya Kiran: India-Nepal army exercise (19th edition, Pithoragarh)

items.headline: Ahmedabad to host 2030 Commonwealth Games
items.detail: The 2030 Commonwealth Games were awarded to Ahmedabad on November 26 in Glasgow, ahead of Abuja. It will be India's second Games after Delhi 2010 and the centenary edition.

items.headline: Constitution Day: Constitution released in nine languages
items.detail: The 76th Constitution Day was observed on November 26, and the Constitution was released in nine languages.

items.headline: Cabinet approves Rs 7,280 crore rare earth magnet scheme
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 7,280 crore scheme to build 6,000 tonnes a year of capacity for sintered rare earth permanent magnets.
examFacts: Rare earth permanent magnet scheme: Rs 7,280 crore

quiz.q: India won its first ICC Women's ODI World Cup in November 2025 by beating which team in the final?
quiz.solution: India beat South Africa by 52 runs at Navi Mumbai; Deepti Sharma was Player of the Tournament.

quiz.q: Who took charge as the 53rd Chief Justice of India in November 2025?
quiz.solution: Justice Surya Kant, the first CJI from Haryana, succeeded Justice B.R. Gavai on November 24, 2025.

quiz.q: Which city will host the 2030 Commonwealth Games?
quiz.solution: The 2030 Games were awarded to Ahmedabad ahead of Abuja.

quiz.q: Which book won the Booker Prize 2025?
quiz.solution: David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize for 'Flesh'.

quiz.q: The four Labour Codes that came into force on November 21, 2025 consolidate how many labour laws?
quiz.solution: The four Codes consolidate 29 labour laws.

quiz.q: Which country will host COP31 in 2026?
quiz.solution: COP30 concluded at Belem, Brazil, and Turkey will host COP31.

quiz.q: Which state was declared India's first to eradicate extreme poverty on November 1, 2025?
quiz.solution: Kerala was declared free of extreme poverty on November 1, 2025.

quiz.q: The 2025 G20 Summit, the first held in Africa, took place in which city?
quiz.solution: The G20 Summit was held in Johannesburg on November 21-23, 2025.

quiz.q: The 1,020 MW Punatsangchhu-II hydroelectric project inaugurated in November 2025 is in which country?
quiz.solution: PM Modi inaugurated the project during his November 11-12 visit to Bhutan.

quiz.q: Which country became the sixth member of the Colombo Security Conclave in November 2025?
quiz.solution: Seychelles joined at the 7th NSA-level meeting in New Delhi.

items.headline: Q2 GDP growth hits six-quarter high of 8.2%
items.detail: India's economy grew 8.2% in July-September 2025, the fastest in six quarters, powered by 9.1% manufacturing growth. Real GDP stood at Rs 48.63 lakh crore for the quarter.

items.headline: Far-right candidate Kast wins Chile's presidential election
items.detail: Jose Antonio Kast won Chile's presidential run-off with about 58% of the vote, becoming the country's 38th President. He succeeds Gabriel Boric and takes office in March 2026.

items.headline: Deepavali added to UNESCO heritage list at Red Fort session
items.detail: At the 20th UNESCO session on Intangible Cultural Heritage held at the Red Fort, New Delhi, India's first time hosting, Deepavali was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
examFacts: Deepavali inscribed on UNESCO ICH list: December 2025
20th ICH session hosted at: Red Fort, New Delhi

items.headline: India third in Asia Power Index among major powers
items.detail: The Lowy Institute's Asia Power Index 2025 placed the USA first, China second and India third with 40 points, formally elevating India to 'Major Power' status among 27 countries assessed.
examFacts: Asia Power Index 2025: USA 1st, China 2nd, India 3rd

items.headline: India jumps to 3rd in Stanford AI Vibrancy rankings
items.detail: Stanford's Global AI Vibrancy Tool 2025 ranked India third with 21.59 points, up from seventh in 2023. The USA and China took the top two spots.
examFacts: Stanford AI Vibrancy 2025: USA 1st, China 2nd, India 3rd

items.headline: India re-elected to IMO Council with top votes
items.detail: India was re-elected to the International Maritime Organization Council in Category B for 2026-27, polling 154 of 169 votes, the highest in its category, at the 34th IMO Assembly in London.

items.headline: Operation Sagar Bandhu aids cyclone-hit Sri Lanka
items.detail: India launched Operation Sagar Bandhu to help Sri Lanka after Cyclone Ditwah, deploying INS Vikrant, INS Udayagiri and IAF aircraft with NDRF teams and tonnes of relief material. It was one of India's largest recent humanitarian missions in the neighbourhood.
examFacts: Operation Sagar Bandhu: relief mission for Sri Lanka (Cyclone Ditwah)
INS Vikrant was deployed for the mission

items.headline: Navy Day celebrated with theme of combat readiness
items.detail: Indian Navy Day was observed on December 4 with the theme 'Combat Ready, Cohesive, Credible and Aatmanirbhar Force'. The Op Demo 2025 was held at Shangumugham Beach, Thiruvananthapuram, with President Murmu as chief guest.
examFacts: Navy Chief: Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi

items.headline: RBI retains SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI as D-SIBs
items.detail: The RBI kept SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank as Domestic Systemically Important Banks for 2025. They must hold extra CET-1 capital of 0.80%, 0.40% and 0.20% respectively.
examFacts: D-SIBs 2025: SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank
Highest extra CET-1 requirement: SBI at 0.80%

items.headline: RBI cuts repo rate to 5.25%
items.detail: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee, chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, cut the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.25% at its December review. The stance stayed neutral, and the FY26 growth forecast was raised to 7.3% after Q2 GDP growth of 8.2%.

items.headline: PMO complex renamed 'Seva Teerth'
items.detail: The Prime Minister's Office complex under the Central Vista project was renamed 'Seva Teerth'. Following an MHA directive, Raj Bhavans across states are being renamed 'Lok Bhavan' and Raj Niwas 'Lok Niwas'.
examFacts: Raj Bhavans being renamed: Lok Bhavan

items.headline: Donald Trump receives first FIFA Peace Prize
items.detail: US President Donald Trump received the inaugural FIFA Peace Prize at the World Cup Final Draw in Washington. The award was presented by FIFA President Gianni Infantino.
examFacts: First FIFA Peace Prize winner: Donald Trump (December 2025)

items.headline: Lando Norris wins maiden F1 world title
items.detail: McLaren's Lando Norris clinched his first Formula One Drivers' Championship after the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, finishing ahead of Max Verstappen and Oscar Piastri in the standings. He became the 11th British champion.

items.headline: Germany wins record 8th Men's Junior Hockey World Cup
items.detail: Germany beat Spain 3-2 in a shoot-out in the final in Chennai to win the FIH Men's Junior Hockey World Cup for a record eighth time. India took bronze, beating Argentina 4-2.
examFacts: Junior Hockey World Cup 2025: Germany (8th title)
Host cities: Chennai and Madurai (Tamil Nadu)

items.headline: Human Rights Day marks 77 years of the UDHR
items.detail: Human Rights Day was observed on December 10, 2025, marking 77 years of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, with the theme 'Human Rights, Our Everyday Essentials'.

items.headline: UPI handles nearly half of global real-time payments
items.detail: Reports highlighted that India's UPI is the world's largest retail fast payment system by volume, handling about 49% of global real-time transactions with 129.3 billion transactions.
examFacts: UPI share of global real-time transactions: about 49%

items.headline: Microsoft to invest USD 17.5 billion in India's AI infrastructure
items.detail: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, on his India visit, announced an investment of USD 17.5 billion (about Rs 1.58 lakh crore) in AI infrastructure for 2026-29. Major IT firms will together deploy over 200,000 Copilot licences.
examFacts: Microsoft's India AI investment: USD 17.5 billion (2026-29)

items.headline: Cabinet approves Rs 11,718 crore for Census 2027
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved Rs 11,718.24 crore for Census 2027, which will be India's first fully digital census. House-listing runs from April 2026 and population enumeration in February 2027.
examFacts: First fully digital census of India

items.headline: UNEA-7 held in Nairobi; Tamil Nadu officer wins Earth award
items.detail: The seventh UN Environment Assembly met in Nairobi with the theme 'Advancing sustainable solutions for a resilient planet'. Tamil Nadu's Supriya Sahu received the UNEP Champions of the Earth Award 2025.
examFacts: Champions of the Earth 2025 (India): Supriya Sahu

items.headline: India wins first Squash World Cup title
items.detail: India's mixed team won its first Squash World Cup, beating top seeds Hong Kong 3-0 in the final in Chennai. India became the first Asian nation to win the title.
examFacts: Squash World Cup 2025 winner: India (first title)

items.headline: Former Home Minister Shivraj Patil dies at 90
items.detail: Shivraj Patil, Union Home Minister from 2004 to 2008 and the 10th Speaker of the Lok Sabha (1991-96), died in Latur, Maharashtra, at 90. He also served as Governor of Punjab.
examFacts: Shivraj Patil: 10th Lok Sabha Speaker, Home Minister 2004-08

items.headline: Raj Kumar Goyal sworn in as Chief Information Commissioner
items.detail: Former IAS officer Raj Kumar Goyal was sworn in as the 13th Chief Information Commissioner of India for a three-year term. Eight new Information Commissioners also joined, filling the information commission's bench completely.
examFacts: 13th Chief Information Commissioner: Raj Kumar Goyal

items.headline: TIME names 'Architects of AI' Person of the Year 2025
items.detail: TIME magazine named the 'Architects of AI' as Person of the Year 2025, honouring leaders such as Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg and Demis Hassabis who built the artificial intelligence boom.
examFacts: TIME Person of the Year 2025: 'Architects of AI'

items.headline: India's Ramsar sites rise to 96
items.detail: India added two more Ramsar wetlands: Siliserh Lake in Alwar, Rajasthan, the 95th site, and Kopra Jalashay near Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, the state's first and the country's 96th. Rajasthan now has five Ramsar sites.

items.headline: Vijay Diwas marks 54 years of the 1971 victory
items.detail: Vijay Diwas was observed on December 16, marking the 54th anniversary of Pakistan's surrender in Dhaka in 1971 after the 13-day war. The surrender led to the creation of Bangladesh.

items.headline: Russia formalises RELOS logistics pact with India
items.detail: Russian President Vladimir Putin signed the Reciprocal Exchange of Logistics Support (RELOS) agreement into federal law. The pact allows the two militaries to use each other's facilities for warship docking, airspace and logistics.
examFacts: Covers warship docking, airspace use and logistics

items.headline: India unveils indigenous 64-bit microprocessor DHRUV64
items.detail: India unveiled DHRUV64, its first indigenously developed 64-bit dual-core microprocessor, built by C-DAC. It is the third chip under the DIR-V programme after THEJAS32 and THEJAS64.
examFacts: DHRUV64: India's first indigenous 64-bit dual-core microprocessor

items.headline: Sai Jadhav first woman to pass out of the Indian Military Academy
items.detail: Twenty-three-year-old Sai Jadhav from Kolhapur became the first woman to pass out of the Indian Military Academy in its 93-year history. She was commissioned as a Lieutenant in the Territorial Army.
examFacts: First woman IMA pass-out: Sai Jadhav (2025)

items.headline: PM Modi's three-nation tour of Jordan, Ethiopia and Oman
items.detail: Prime Minister Modi visited Jordan, Ethiopia and Oman from December 15-18, 2025. India and Ethiopia upgraded ties to a Strategic Partnership during his first bilateral visit, while in Oman the India-Oman CEPA was signed and he received the 'Order of Oman', his 29th foreign honour.
examFacts: PM Modi's December 2025 tour: Jordan, Ethiopia, Oman
India-Ethiopia ties upgraded to Strategic Partnership

items.headline: WHO summit on traditional medicine held in New Delhi
items.detail: The 2nd WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on the theme 'Restoring Balance'. Prime Minister Modi launched the My Ayush Integrated Services Portal and the 'Ayush Mark' quality certification.
examFacts: 2nd WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine: New Delhi
'Ayush Mark': quality certification for Ayush products

items.headline: Jnanpith-winning writer Vinod Kumar Shukla dies at 88
items.detail: Hindi writer Vinod Kumar Shukla died in Raipur at 88. He won the 59th Jnanpith Award for 2025, the first writer from Chhattisgarh to receive it, and earlier won the PEN/Nabokov Award.

items.headline: New rural jobs law VB-G RAM G gets assent
items.detail: President Murmu gave assent to the VB-G RAM G law, which replaces the 2005 rural employment law from 2026. It raises the guaranteed wage employment from 100 to 125 days per rural household a year.
examFacts: Wage employment guarantee raised to: 125 days a year

items.headline: Pakistan wins U-19 Asia Cup beating India
items.detail: Pakistan beat India by 191 runs in the final of the ACC U-19 Asia Cup in Dubai to win its second title. Sameer Minhas scored 172, the highest score in a U-19 Asia Cup final, and was Player of the Tournament.
examFacts: U-19 Asia Cup 2025 winner: Pakistan (beat India by 191 runs)
Player of the Tournament: Sameer Minhas (172)

items.headline: Satwik-Chirag create history at BWF World Tour Finals
items.detail: At the BWF World Tour Finals in Hangzhou, France's Christo Popov and Korea's An Se-young won the men's and women's singles titles. India's Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty won men's doubles bronze, India's first medal in that event at the finals.
examFacts: BWF World Tour Finals 2025: Hangzhou, China
Satwik-Chirag: first Indian men's doubles medallists at the event

items.headline: National Mathematics Day marks Ramanujan's anniversary
items.detail: National Mathematics Day was observed on December 22, the 138th birth anniversary of mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan. The day has been celebrated since 2011.

items.headline: SHANTI Bill gets Presidential assent to expand nuclear power
items.detail: The President approved the SHANTI law on nuclear energy, allowing private companies to build and operate nuclear plants under licensing. India targets 100 GW of nuclear capacity by 2047, up from about 8.9 GW, with up to 49% FDI permitted.
examFacts: SHANTI law replaces: Atomic Energy Act, 1962

items.headline: India achieves 20% ethanol blending in petrol
items.detail: The government announced that India achieved 20% ethanol blending in petrol in November 2025, five years ahead of the original 2030 target under the Ethanol Blending Programme.

items.headline: Statue of Unity sculptor Ram Vanji Sutar dies at 100
items.detail: Renowned sculptor Ram Vanji Sutar, who designed the 182-metre Statue of Unity, died in Noida at 100. He was honoured with the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan and the Tagore Award.
examFacts: Statue of Unity sculptor: Ram Vanji Sutar (1925-2025)

items.headline: LVM3 launches heaviest payload BlueBird Block-2
items.detail: ISRO's LVM3-M6 rocket launched the 6,100 kg BlueBird Block-2 satellite, the heaviest payload ever carried by an LVM3, from Sriharikota. Built by AST SpaceMobile of the USA, it will provide direct satellite broadband to smartphones.
examFacts: Heaviest LVM3 payload: BlueBird Block-2 (6,100 kg)

items.headline: NPS rules eased: lock-in removed, exit age raised to 85
items.detail: PFRDA amended NPS rules, removing the mandatory five-year lock-in and allowing lump-sum withdrawal of up to 80% of the corpus with 20% annuity. The maximum entry age under the system was raised from 75 to 85 years.
examFacts: Maximum NPS age raised to: 85 years

items.headline: Good Governance Day marks Vajpayee's 101st birth anniversary
items.detail: Good Governance Day was observed on December 25, 2025, the 101st birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. The day has been observed since 2014.
examFacts: Good Governance Day: 25 December (Atal Bihari Vajpayee's birthday)

items.headline: PV Sindhu elected BWF Athletes' Commission Chair
items.detail: Two-time Olympic medallist PV Sindhu was elected Chair of the BWF Athletes' Commission for 2026-29, succeeding Indonesia's Greysia Polii.
examFacts: BWF Athletes' Commission Chair (2026-29): PV Sindhu

items.headline: India tests K-4 submarine-launched ballistic missile
items.detail: India successfully test-fired the K-4 ballistic missile from nuclear submarine INS Arighaat in the Bay of Bengal. The DRDO-developed missile can strike targets about 3,500 km away.

items.headline: Bangladesh's first woman PM Khaleda Zia dies
items.detail: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Khaleda Zia died in Dhaka at 80. The BNP chief served as Prime Minister from 1991-96 and 2001-06 and was the country's first woman head of government.
examFacts: Khaleda Zia: Bangladesh's first woman Prime Minister

quiz.q: What is India's repo rate after the RBI Monetary Policy review of December 2025?
quiz.solution: The MPC cut the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.25% in December 2025.

quiz.q: Which Indian festival was inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in December 2025?
quiz.solution: Deepavali was added to UNESCO's Representative List at the 20th ICH session held at the Red Fort, New Delhi.

quiz.q: Under the VB-G RAM G law, the guaranteed wage employment per rural household per year is:
quiz.solution: The new law replaced the 2005 rural employment law and raised the guarantee from 100 to 125 days.

quiz.q: Census 2027, approved by the Union Cabinet in December 2025, will be special because it is:
options: India's first census with foreign observers
quiz.solution: Census 2027, with an outlay of Rs 11,718.24 crore, will be India's first fully digital census.

quiz.q: Khaleda Zia, who died in December 2025, was the first woman Prime Minister of which country?
quiz.solution: Khaleda Zia, BNP chief, was Bangladesh's first woman Prime Minister (1991-96 and 2001-06).

quiz.q: India won its first Squash World Cup in December 2025 by beating which team in the final?
quiz.solution: India beat top seeds Hong Kong 3-0 in the final in Chennai, becoming the first Asian champion.

quiz.q: Which team won the ACC U-19 Asia Cup 2025, beating India in the final?
quiz.solution: Pakistan beat India by 191 runs in the final in Dubai for its second U-19 Asia Cup title.

quiz.q: Lando Norris, the 2025 Formula One world champion, drives for which team?
quiz.solution: Norris won his maiden Drivers' Championship with McLaren after the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.

quiz.q: From which submarine was India's K-4 ballistic missile test-fired in December 2025?
quiz.solution: The K-4, with a range of about 3,500 km, was tested from INS Arighaat in the Bay of Bengal.

quiz.q: Kopra Jalashay, named India's 96th Ramsar site in December 2025, is located in which state?
quiz.solution: Kopra Jalashay near Bilaspur became Chhattisgarh's first Ramsar site and India's 96th.
